component.name: Psysonic
component.summary: Desktop music player for self-hosted Subsonic-compatible servers

description.p: Psysonic is a desktop music player for self-hosted libraries. It is built primarily for Navidrome and also works with Gonic, Airsonic, LMS, and other Subsonic-compatible servers when they provide the required APIs.
Browse and search large libraries, manage playlists and the play queue, download music for offline playback, view synced lyrics, and control playback through desktop media controls.

ul.li: Combine music from multiple servers into one local library
Analyse loudness, waveform, and tempo on your device
Use gapless playback, crossfade, and content-aware AutoDJ transitions
Customise the interface with built-in and community themes

screenshot.caption: Browse recently played music and recommendations
View track details and manage the play queue
Control playback in the fullscreen Now Playing view
